techniques.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/prompt/templates.rs:207 capture is demanded per run (1-3 items) rather than at meaningful boundaries; contradicted by src-tauri/engine/src/prompt/assemble.rs:630

src-tauri/engine/src/prompt/assemble.rs:595 recalled episodes are labeled as memory/data that cannot instruct, nonce-fenced at :599, role+timestamp per row (:588 area) and hard-capped at 8 (:28); persona-memory recall itself lives outside this context (src-tauri/src/engine/runner/mod.rs:1316)

pairs.registryProposal: The governing map row covers only src-tauri/engine/src/prompt/*; the persona-memory recall block is assembled in src-tauri/src/engine/runner/mod.rs, which is in no context for this subject. Only 2 of the subject's 30 techniques could be read here, so no conformant verdict was possible; consider a pair for the runner context.

pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: src/lib/execution/knowledgeMiddleware.ts:84 injected knowledge guidance is appended to the user's inputData (the most-trusted channel) as an unlabeled '[Knowledge Graph Guidance]' block with no as-of/age or sample count, and :41-47 failure_pattern entries carry no confidence floor (tool_sequence :28 and model_performance :55 do), so an unconfirmed one-off failure string is served to the model as standing advice

techniques.evidence: src/lib/execution/knowledgeMiddleware.ts:84 injected items lack age/confirmation labelling and the omitted count (slice(0,3) at :44 drops the rest silently); failure_pattern at :41 skips the confidence gate used at :28 and :55
src/lib/execution/knowledgeMiddleware.ts:90 a failed read logs a warning and continues, so the model gets no signal that its guidance was unavailable (failure indistinguishable from empty recall)

pairs.registryProposal: Execution-derived knowledge (tool sequences, failure patterns) is not agent memory in the subject's three-layer sense; the pairing is technique-shaped (recall-injection labelling) rather than precondition-shaped. A short note in recall-injection on derived-statistics stores would settle whether this is in scope.
